versions.changelog:
- Initial release of browser-mcp skill.
- Enables remote control of Chrome via the Chrome DevTools MCP protocol for web automation tasks.
- Supports navigation, element interaction, form filling, multistep workflows, page information extraction, and SSRF whitelist configuration.
- Includes detailed usage documentation, quick-start guides, full action/operation reference, troubleshooting notes, and environment setup instructions for Windows 11.
- Prepared for future support of remote connection from Linux/Mac to Windows-hosted Chrome sessions.
